value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete spectral-support class where minimal commutants persist under arbitrary finite nesting and nonconcentric distortion, including dense boundary point spectra and no regularity of Jordan loops. It resolves a substantive obstacle: uniform polynomial separation of the component spectra is impossible for nested loops, so published direct-sum criteria do not settle the case. The general atomic boundary-peeling mechanism is naturally reusable beyond a one-curve or radial classification; no downstream theorem or paper-sized result is needed for this structural value.
